rationale: Adds tools/scripts/dawn_binding_census.py, a read-only check that counts Dawn implementations in built artifacts (nm/otool over Mach-O images), its selftest, acceptance item 6a in the editor-host runner, a tools.yaml entry with its generated CLAUDE.md digest line, and a skia-gpu-build skill note.
